recipes.name: Vegan Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 cup canned hearts of palm, (drained and rinsed and roughly chopped (165g)*)
1 tablespoon Dijon mustard ((or spicy brown mustard))
2 tablespoons dill pickle relish ((or sweet pickle relish))
2 nori sheets, (crumbled with your hands into small pieces)
8 slices of hearty sandwich bread (or sliced baguette )
Sandwich fixings of choice: romaine or leaf lettuce, (sliced or shaved cucumber, sliced tomatoes, fresh dill sprigs, pickles)
instructions: In a food processor bowl, combine the chickpeas, hearts of palm, mayo, mustard, celery, celery seeds, relish, nutritional yeast, crumbled nori, lemon juice, salt, and several cracks of pepper. Do not blend! Pulse about 10 to 15 times, until incorporated and combined but still chunky. Taste, adding more salt and pepper as needed. But stir them in by hand instead of pulsing to avoid over-blending.

If making sandwiches, spread the tuna salad onto four slices of bread. Top with your desired sandwich toppings. Top each with another slice of bread (for extra richness, add a thin layer of vegan mayo to this slice of bread). Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes *If hearts of palm aren’t available, sub with more chickpeas. ** We like Follow Your Heart Vegenaise and Sir Kensington’s vegan mayo in the RPL kitchen.
